items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Well, I met Bunk. The first time I ever heard Bunk play was in Houston, Texas... I said, that's Bunk Johnson. And I said, well, that's Bunk.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Bunk or run across him out there?

Well, I met Bunk. The first time I ever heard Bunk play was in Houston, Texas. I used to hear him talk about Bunk, but I had never heard him play. So one day we were playing an advertisement in a wagon for a dance. And they were on a wagon playing an advertisement for a show, for a theater. And this guy played, oh, played trumpet, you know, jazz. And I said, who is it? I said, who is that trumpet playing? They said, don't you know him? I said, well, no. I never, I don't know him.
